player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I returned to the starting Utility room and immediately declared "DONE" without checking if other rooms remained unvisited. I assumed the path was complete after returning to a known location, but I never tracked the set of visited rooms. Next time, I will maintain a mental list of visited rooms. When I return to the Utility room, I will check the available directions (currently only east) and verify if the neighbor (Attic) has been fully explored or if other branches exist. I will only say "DONE" when I have confirmed that all reachable rooms from the current position have been visited and no new directions lead to unvisited areas. Specifically, from the Utility room, since only "east" is available and I just came from there, I should have realized I am stuck in a dead end only if Attic offers no further unvisited paths, but I must explicitly confirm Attic is fully explored before stopping.
